subject: Animation
title: Winsor McCay: The First Animation Genius
description: A fast breakdown of Winsor McCay: The First Animation Genius for builders.

hook.text: Winsor McCay hand-drew 10,000 frames to create Gertie the Dinosaur in 1914, astonishing live audiences.

buildup.text: McCay performed live on stage, seemingly giving commands to Gertie who responded on the screen behind him.

discovery.text: Gertie had personality — she was playful, stubborn, and emotional. McCay invented character animation.

twist.text: McCay was a newspaper cartoonist first. His boss at Hearst Publishing hated his film work as a distraction.

climax.text: McCay proved that animated characters could have personality and emotion, not just movement.

punchline.text: A newspaper artist gave animation its soul.

quiz.question: What did Winsor McCay pioneer with Gertie the Dinosaur?
options: Character animation — giving an animated figure personality, emotion, and interactive stage performance
